title: नवमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 9 · Dhritarashtra recovers and hears of Krishna's deeds

summary.en: Dhritarashtra faints, is revived and asks Sanjaya to continue, wondering how Arjuna was not struck down. Sanjaya begins to praise Narayana, the true protector of Arjuna.
summary.kn: ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ಮೂರ್ಛೆಹೋಗಿ ಎಚ್ಚರಗೊಂಡು ಸಂಜಯನನ್ನು ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅರ್ಜುನ ಹೇಗೆ ಉಳಿದನೆಂದು ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯಪಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸಂಜಯ ಅರ್ಜುನನ ನಿಜ ರಕ್ಷಕ ನಾರಾಯಣನನ್ನು ಸ್ತುತಿಸಲು ಆರಂಭಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र मूर्छित होकर होश में आते हैं और संजय को आगे बताने को कहते हैं, यह सोचकर कि अर्जुन कैसे बचा रहा। संजय अर्जुन के सच्चे रक्षक नारायण की स्तुति आरम्भ करते हैं।
summary.te: ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు మూర్ఛపోయి తేరుకుని సంజయుని కొనసాగమంటాడు; అర్జునుడు ఎలా నిలిచాడా అని ఆశ్చర్యపడతాడు. సంజయుడు అర్జునుని నిజమైన రక్షకుడైన నారాయణుని స్తుతించడం మొదలుపెడతాడు.
summary.ta: த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் மயங்கித் தெளிந்து சஞ்சயனைத் தொடரச் சொல்லி, அர்ஜுனன் எப்படித் தப்பினான் என்று வியக்கிறான். அர்ஜுனனின் உண்மைக் காவலனான நாராயணனைச் சஞ்சயன் புகழத் தொடங்குகிறான்.
summary.ml: ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ബോധംകെട്ടുവീഴുന്നു, ഉണർന്നശേഷം സഞ്ജയനോട് തുടരാൻ ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു; അർജുനൻ എങ്ങനെ വീഴാതിരുന്നുവെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം അത്ഭുതപ്പെടുന്നു. അർജുനന്റെ യഥാർഥ രക്ഷകനായ നാരായണനെ സഞ്ജയൻ സ്തുതിച്ചുതുടങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.9; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवं पृष्ट्वा सूतपुत्रं हृच्छोकेनार्दितो भृशम् ।
जये निराशः पुत्राणां धृतराष्ट्रोऽपतत्क्षितौ ॥

meaning.en: Having questioned the charioteer's son thus, Dhritarashtra, tormented by grief in his heart and hopeless of his sons' victory, fell to the ground.

verses.text:
तं विसंज्ञं निपतितं सिषिचुः परिचारकाः ।
जलेनात्यर्थशीतेन वीजन्तः पुण्यगन्धिना ॥

meaning.en: As he lay fallen and unconscious, his attendants sprinkled him with very cold, sweet-scented water, fanning him.

verses.text:
पतितं चैनमाज्ञाय समन्ताद्भरतस्त्रियः ।
परिवव्रुर्महाराजमस्पृशंश्चैव पाणिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Knowing that he had fallen, the Bharata women gathered around the great king on every side and touched him with their hands.

verses.text:
उत्थाप्य चैनं शनकै राजानं पृथिवीतलात् ।
आसनं प्रापयामासुर्बाष्पकण्ठ्यो वराङ्गनाः ॥

meaning.en: Slowly raising the king from the ground, the fair women, their throats choked with tears, brought him to a seat.

verses.text:
आसनं प्राप्य राजा तु मूर्छयाभिपरिप्लुतः ।
निश्चेष्टोऽतिष्ठत तदा वीज्यमानः समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Seated, the king, flooded by his swoon, remained motionless then, fanned from all sides.

verses.text:
स लब्ध्वा शनकैः संज्ञां वेपमानो महीपतिः ।
पुनर्गावल्गणिं सूतं पर्यपृच्छद्यथातथम् ॥

meaning.en: Slowly regaining consciousness, trembling, the king again questioned Sanjaya, Gavalgana's son, exactly.

verses.text:
यत्तदुद्यन्निवादित्यो ज्योतिषा प्रणुदंस्तमः ।
आयादजातशत्रुर्वै कस्तं द्रोणादवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: When Ajatashatru came up like the rising sun, driving away darkness with his light, who held him back from Drona?

verses.text:
प्रभिन्नमिव मातङ्गं तथा क्रुद्धं तरस्विनम् ।
आसक्तमनसं दीप्तं प्रतिद्विरदघातिनम् ।
वाशितासंगमे यद्वदजय्यं प्रतियूथपैः ॥

meaning.en: Who stopped him, raging like a mighty tusker in rut, intent, blazing, killing rival elephants, unconquerable by rival herd-leaders when they meet over a cow elephant?

verses.text:
अति चान्यान्रणे योधान्वीरः पुरुषसत्तमः ।
यो ह्येको हि महाबाहुर्निर्दहेद्घोरचक्षुषा ।
कृत्स्नं दुर्योधनबलं धृतिमान्सत्यसंगरः ॥

meaning.en: That mighty-armed hero, best of men, with a terrible gaze, steady and true to his word, could burn alone, the whole of Duryodhana's army, surpassing other warriors in battle.

verses.text:
चक्षुर्हणं जये सक्तमिष्वासवररक्षितम् ।
दान्तं बहुमतं लोके के शूराः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Which brave men surrounded him, eye-destroying, intent on victory, guarded by the best of archers, self-controlled, highly esteemed in the world?

verses.text:
के दुष्प्रधर्षं राजानमिष्वासवरमच्युतम् ।
समासेदुर्नरव्याघ्रं कौन्तेयं तत्र मामकाः ॥

meaning.en: Who among my men met there Kunti's son, that king hard to assail, the best bowman, unfailing tiger among men?

verses.text:
तरसैवाभिपत्याथ यो वै द्रोणमुपाद्रवत् ।
तं भीमसेनमायान्तं के शूराः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: And Bhimasena, who fell on Drona with sheer force and attacked him as he came on, which heroes surrounded him?

verses.text:
यदायाज्जलदप्रख्यो रथः परमवीर्यवान् ।
पर्जन्य इव बीभत्सुस्तुमुलामशनिं सृजन् ॥

meaning.en: When the chariot of supreme power, like a cloud, came, with Bibhatsu like Parjanya sending a tumultuous thunderbolt,

verses.text:
ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि वर्षाणि मघवानिव ।
इषुसंबाधमाकाशं कुर्वन्कपिवरध्वजः ।
अवस्फूर्जन्दिशः सर्वास्तलनेमिस्वनेन च ॥

meaning.en: and rained down showers of arrows like Maghavan, filling the sky with arrows, his banner showing a great monkey, and shaking all directions with the noise of his palms and wheel rims,

verses.text:
चापविद्युत्प्रभो घोरो रथगुल्मबलाहकः ।
रथनेमिघोषस्तनितः शरशब्दातिबन्धुरः ॥

meaning.en: lightning-bright with the bow, fearsome, with his chariot clump as a cloud-mass, thundering with the sound of wheel rims, charming with the sound of arrows,

verses.text:
रोषनिर्जितजीमूतो मनोऽभिप्रायशीघ्रगः ।
मर्मातिगो बाणधारस्तुमुलः शोणितोदकः ॥

meaning.en: surpassing the clouds in fury, swift as the mind's wish, piercing vital points, with arrows as streams, tumultuous, with blood as water,

verses.text:
संप्लावयन्महीं सर्वां मानवैरास्तरंस्तदा ।
गदानिष्टनितो रौद्रो दुर्योधनकृतोद्यमः ॥

meaning.en: flooding the whole earth, strewing it with men, fearsome with the clang of maces, undertaken for Duryodhana's sake,

verses.text:
युद्धेऽभ्यषिञ्चद्विजयो गार्ध्रपत्रैः शिलाशितैः ।
गाण्डीवं धारयन्धीमान्कीदृशं वो मनस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Vijaya anointed the battle with arrows feathered with vulture plumes and whetted on stone, holding the Gandiva, the wise one. What was your mind then?

verses.text:
कच्चिद्गाण्डीवशब्देन न प्रणश्यत वै बलम् ।
यद्वः स भैरवं कुर्वन्नर्जुनो भृशमभ्यगात् ॥

meaning.en: I hope your forces did not perish at the sound of the Gandiva, when Arjuna came at you, making a dreadful din.

verses.text:
कच्चिन्नापानुदद्द्रोणादिषुभिर्वो धनंजयः ।
वातो मेघानिवाविध्यन्प्रवाञ्शरवनानिलः ।
को हि गाण्डीवधन्वानं नरः सोढुं रणेऽर्हति ॥

meaning.en: I hope Dhananjaya did not drive you away from Drona with his arrows, like a wind scattering clouds, the arrow-forest wind. For what man can withstand the wielder of the Gandiva in battle?

verses.text:
यत्सेनाः समकम्पन्त यद्वीरानस्पृशद्भयम् ।
के तत्र नाजहुर्द्रोणं के क्षुद्राः प्राद्रवन्भयात् ॥

meaning.en: When the armies shook and fear touched the heroes, who did not abandon Drona there, and which base ones fled in terror?

verses.text:
के वा तत्र तनूस्त्यक्त्वा प्रतीपं मृत्युमाव्रजन् ।
अमानुषाणां जेतारं युद्धेष्वपि धनंजयम् ॥

meaning.en: And who there gave up his body and met death facing Dhananjaya, conqueror even of superhuman beings in battle?

verses.text:
न च वेगं सिताश्वस्य विशक्ष्यन्तीह मामकाः ।
गाण्डीवस्य च निर्घोषं प्रावृड्जलदनिस्वनम् ॥

meaning.en: My men will not be able to bear the speed of the white-horsed one, and the roar of the Gandiva like the thunder of a rain cloud.

verses.text:
विष्वक्सेनो यस्य यन्ता योद्धा चैव धनंजयः ।
अशक्यः स रथो जेतुं मन्ये देवासुरैरपि ॥

meaning.en: That chariot, whose charioteer is Vishvaksena and whose fighter is Dhananjaya, I think cannot be conquered even by gods and asuras.

verses.text:
सुकुमारो युवा शूरो दर्शनीयश्च पाण्डवः ।
मेधावी निपुणो धीमान्युधि सत्यपराक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandava, tender, young, brave and fair to look at, intelligent, skilled and wise, of true valor in battle, Nakula,

verses.text:
आरावं विपुलं कुर्वन्व्यथयन्सर्वकौरवान् ।
यदायान्नकुलो धीमान्के शूराः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: when he came, making a vast din and troubling all the Kauravas, which heroes surrounded him?

verses.text:
आशीविष इव क्रुद्धः सहदेवो यदाभ्ययात् ।
शत्रूणां कदनं कुर्वञ्जेतासौ दुर्जयो युधि ॥

meaning.en: When Sahadeva came on, angry like a venomous snake, destroying the enemy, a conqueror hard to beat in battle,

verses.text:
आर्यव्रतममोघेषुं ह्रीमन्तमपराजितम् ।
द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं के शूराः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: that modest, undefeated one of noble vows and unfailing arrows, advancing toward Drona, which heroes surrounded him?

verses.text:
यः स सौवीरराजस्य प्रमथ्य महतीं चमूम् ।
आदत्त महिषीं भोज्यां काम्यां सर्वाङ्गशोभनाम् ॥

meaning.en: He who crushed the great army of the king of Sauvira and carried off the lovely Bhoja queen, beautiful in every limb,

verses.text:
सत्यं धृतिश्च शौर्यं च ब्रह्मचर्यं च केवलम् ।
सर्वाणि युयुधानेऽस्मिन्नित्यानि पुरुषर्षभे ॥

meaning.en: truth, steadiness, courage and pure chastity, all these are always in that bull among men, Yuyudhana.

verses.text:
बलिनं सत्यकर्माणमदीनमपराजितम् ।
वासुदेवसमं युद्धे वासुदेवादनन्तरम् ॥

meaning.en: Strong, of true deeds, unbroken, undefeated, equal to Vasudeva in battle, next after Vasudeva,

verses.text:
युक्तं धनंजयप्रेष्ये शूरमाचार्यकर्मणि ।
पार्थेन सममस्त्रेषु कस्तं द्रोणादवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: devoted to Dhananjaya's service, a hero, doing a teacher's work, equal to Partha in weapons: who held him back from Drona?

verses.text:
वृष्णीनां प्रवरं वीरं शूरं सर्वधनुष्मताम् ।
रामेण सममस्त्रेषु यशसा विक्रमेण च ॥

meaning.en: He is the best hero of the Vrishnis, brave among all archers, equal to Rama in weapons, fame and valor.

verses.text:
सत्यं धृतिर्दमः शौर्यं ब्रह्मचर्यमनुत्तमम् ।
सात्वते तानि सर्वाणि त्रैलोक्यमिव केशवे ॥

meaning.en: Truth, steadiness, restraint, courage and the highest chastity, all these are in that Satvata, as the three worlds are in Keshava.

verses.text:
तमेवंगुणसंपन्नं दुर्वारमपि दैवतैः ।
समासाद्य महेष्वासं के वीराः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Endowed with such qualities, hard to check even for gods, that great archer: which heroes met and surrounded him?

verses.text:
पाञ्चालेषूत्तमं शूरमुत्तमाभिजनप्रियम् ।
नित्यमुत्तमकर्माणमुत्तमौजसमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: The best hero among the Panchalas, loved by the best of families, always of best deeds, of best vigor in battle,

verses.text:
युक्तं धनंजयहिते ममानर्थाय चोत्तमम् ।
यमवैश्रवणादित्यमहेन्द्रवरुणोपमम् ॥

meaning.en: devoted to Dhananjaya's good and to my misfortune, the best, comparable to Yama, Vaishravana, the sun, Mahendra and Varuna,

verses.text:
महारथसमाख्यातं द्रोणायोद्यन्तमाहवे ।
त्यजन्तं तुमुले प्राणान्के शूराः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: famed as a great chariot-warrior, rising in battle against Drona and giving up his life in the turmoil: which heroes surrounded him?

verses.text:
एकोऽपसृत्य चेदिभ्यः पाण्डवान्यः समाश्रितः ।
धृष्टकेतुं तमायान्तं द्रोणात्कः समवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: He who, leaving the Chedis alone, took refuge with the Pandavas, Dhrishtaketu, as he came on: who held him back from Drona?

verses.text:
योऽवधीत्केतुमाञ्शूरो राजपुत्रं सुदर्शनम् ।
अपरान्तगिरिद्वारे कस्तं द्रोणादवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: The hero Ketuman, who killed the prince Sudarshana at the Aparanta mountain pass: who held him back from Drona?

verses.text:
स्त्रीपूर्वो यो नरव्याघ्रो यः स वेद गुणागुणान् ।
शिखण्डिनं याज्ञसेनिमम्लानमनसं युधि ॥

meaning.en: The tiger among men who was a woman earlier and knows the good and bad of things, Shikhandi, Yajnasena's son, of unwearied mind in battle,

verses.text:
देवव्रतस्य समरे हेतुं मृत्योर्महात्मनः ।
द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं के वीराः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: the cause of the great-souled Devavrata's death in battle, advancing toward Drona: which heroes surrounded him?

verses.text:
यस्मिन्नभ्यधिका वीरे गुणाः सर्वे धनंजयात् ।
यस्मिन्नस्त्राणि सत्यं च ब्रह्मचर्यं च नित्यदा ॥

meaning.en: He in whom all qualities exceed even Dhananjaya's, in whom there are always weapons, truth and chastity,

verses.text:
वासुदेवसमं वीर्ये धनंजयसमं बले ।
तेजसादित्यसदृशं बृहस्पतिसमं मतौ ॥

meaning.en: equal to Vasudeva in valor, to Dhananjaya in strength, like the sun in radiance, like Brihaspati in intelligence,

verses.text:
अभिमन्युं महात्मानं व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम् ।
द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं के वीराः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: the great-souled Abhimanyu, like Death with gaping mouth, advancing against Drona: which heroes surrounded him?

verses.text:
तरुणस्त्वरुणप्रख्यः सौभद्रः परवीरहा ।
यदाभ्याद्रवत द्रोणं तदासीद्वो मनः कथम् ॥

meaning.en: When young Subhadra's son, red as dawn, slayer of enemy heroes, ran against Drona, what then was your state of mind?

verses.text:
द्रौपदेया नरव्याघ्राः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः ।
यद्द्रोणमाद्रवन्संख्ये के वीरास्तानवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: When the sons of Draupadi, tigers among men, rushed upon Drona like rivers into the sea, which heroes held them back?

verses.text:
ये ते द्वादशवर्षाणि क्रीडामुत्सृज्य बालकाः ।
अस्त्रार्थमवसन्भीष्मे बिभ्रतो व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Those who for twelve years gave up play as boys and lived with Bhishma for weapons, keeping a high vow,

verses.text:
क्षत्रंजयः क्षत्रदेवः क्षत्रधर्मा च मानिनः ।
धृष्टद्युम्नात्मजा वीराः के तान्द्रोणादवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Kshatranjaya, Kshatradeva and the proud Kshatradharma, Dhrishtadyumna's sons: which heroes held them back from Drona?

verses.text:
शताद्विशिष्टं यं युद्धे समपश्यन्त वृष्णयः ।
चेकितानं महेष्वासं कस्तं द्रोणादवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Chekitana, the great archer whom the Vrishnis saw in battle as better than a hundred, who held him back from Drona?

verses.text:
वार्धक्षेमिः कलिङ्गानां यः कन्यामाहरद्युधि ।
अनाधृष्टिरदीनात्मा कस्तं द्रोणादवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Anadhrishti, son of Vriddhakshemi, of unshaken spirit, who carried off the Kalinga maiden in battle: who held him back from Drona?

verses.text:
भ्रातरः पञ्च कैकेया धार्मिकाः सत्यविक्रमाः ।
इन्द्रगोपकवर्णाश्च रक्तवर्मायुधध्वजाः ॥

meaning.en: The five Kekaya brothers, righteous and truly valiant, with the color of the indragopa insect, and red armor, weapons and banners,

verses.text:
मातृष्वसुः सुता वीराः पाण्डवानां जयार्थिनः ।
तान्द्रोणं हन्तुमायातान्के वीराः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: heroes, sons of the Pandavas' mother's sister, seeking their victory, as they came to kill Drona: which heroes surrounded them?

verses.text:
यं योधयन्तो राजानो नाजयन्वारणावते ।
षण्मासानभिसंरब्धा जिघांसन्तो युधां पतिम् ॥

meaning.en: That tiger among men, strong and true to his word, best of archers, eager to fight, whom the kings fighting at Varanavata for six months in rage, wishing to kill the lord of warriors, could not defeat: who held him back from Drona?

verses.text:
धनुष्मतां वरं शूरं सत्यसंधं महाबलम् ।
द्रोणात्कस्तं नरव्याघ्रं युयुत्सुं प्रत्यवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: He is the best of archers, brave and of great strength. Who held that tiger among men back from Drona?

verses.text:
यः पुत्रं काशिराजस्य वाराणस्यां महारथम् ।
समरे स्त्रीषु गृध्यन्तं भल्लेनापहरद्रथात् ॥

meaning.en: He who at Varanasi, with a broad arrow, took the son of the Kashi king, a great chariot-warrior, off his chariot as he lusted for women in battle,

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नं महेष्वासं पार्थानां मन्त्रधारिणम् ।
युक्तं दुर्योधनानर्थे सृष्टं द्रोणवधाय च ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna, the great archer, the counsellor of the Parthas, bent on Duryodhana's ruin and created for Drona's death,

verses.text:
निर्दहन्तं रणे योधान्दारयन्तं च सर्वशः ।
द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं के वीराः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: burning and tearing warriors on every side in battle, advancing toward Drona: which heroes surrounded him?

verses.text:
उत्सङ्ग इव संवृद्धं द्रुपदस्यास्त्रवित्तमम् ।
शैखण्डिनं क्षत्रदेवं के तं द्रोणादवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Shikhandi's son Kshatradeva, grown up as if in Drupada's lap, best versed in weapons: who held him back from Drona?

verses.text:
य इमां पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां चर्मवत्समवेष्टयत् ।
महता रथवंशेन मुख्यारिघ्नो महारथः ॥

meaning.en: He who wrapped this whole earth like a hide with his great line of chariots, the great chariot-warrior, chief slayer of foes,

verses.text:
दशाश्वमेधानाजह्रे स्वन्नपानाप्तदक्षिणान् ।
निरर्गलान्सर्वमेधान्पुत्रवत्पालयन्प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: performed ten horse sacrifices with good food and drink and gifts, and all-sacrifices without restriction, protecting his subjects like sons.

verses.text:
पिबन्त्यो दक्षिणां यस्य गङ्गास्रोतः समापिबन् ।
तावतीर्गा ददौ वीर उशीनरसुतोऽध्वरे ॥

meaning.en: The heroic son of Ushinara gave in a sacrifice as many cows as could drink up the stream of the Ganga.

verses.text:
न पूर्वे नापरे चक्रुरिदं केचन मानवाः ।
इति संचुक्रुशुर्देवाः कृते कर्मणि दुष्करे ॥

meaning.en: "No other humans before or after have done this," the gods cried out at that hard deed.

verses.text:
पश्यामस्त्रिषु लोकेषु न तं संस्थास्नुचारिषु ।
जातं वापि जनिष्यं वा द्वितीयं वापि संप्रति ॥

meaning.en: "We see no equal to him in the three worlds among the moving and unmoving, born or to be born, or even a second one now."

verses.text:
अन्यमौशीनराच्छैब्याद्धुरो वोढारमित्युत ।
गतिं यस्य न यास्यन्ति मानुषा लोकवासिनः ॥

meaning.en: "We see none other than the Aushinara Shaibya to bear the burden, whose way mortals living in the world cannot follow."

verses.text:
तस्य नप्तारमायान्तं शैब्यं कः समवारयत् ।
द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम् ॥

meaning.en: Who held back his grandson, the Shaibya, as he came on toward Drona like Death with gaping mouth?

verses.text:
विराटस्य रथानीकं मत्स्यस्यामित्रघातिनः ।
प्रेप्सन्तं समरे द्रोणं के वीराः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeking Drona in battle, the chariot division of Virata, the Matsya king and slayer of foes: which heroes surrounded them?

verses.text:
सद्यो वृकोदराज्जातो महाबलपराक्रमः ।
मायावी राक्षसो घोरो यस्मान्मम महद्भयम् ॥

meaning.en: Born at once from Vrikodara, of great strength and prowess, the terrible, magical rakshasa from whom I have great fear,

verses.text:
पार्थानां जयकामं तं पुत्राणां मम कण्टकम् ।
घटोत्कचं महाबाहुं कस्तं द्रोणादवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Ghatotkacha, mighty-armed, wishing victory to the Parthas and a thorn to my sons: who held him back from Drona?

verses.text:
एते चान्ये च बहवो येषामर्थाय संजय ।
त्यक्तारः संयुगे प्राणान्किं तेषामजितं युधि ॥

meaning.en: These and many others, Sanjaya, for whose sake men are ready to give up their lives in battle: what is there that they cannot win?

verses.text:
येषां च पुरुषव्याघ्रः शार्ङ्गधन्वा व्यपाश्रयः ।
हितार्थी चापि पार्थानां कथं तेषां पराजयः ॥

meaning.en: And those who have as their refuge the tiger among men, the wielder of the Sharnga bow, who wishes the Parthas well, how can they be defeated?

verses.text:
लोकानां गुरुरत्यन्तं लोकनाथः सनातनः ।
नारायणो रणे नाथो दिव्यो दिव्यात्मवान्प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: He is the supreme teacher of the worlds, the eternal lord of worlds, Narayana, the divine, lord, the divine-souled one and guardian in battle.

verses.text:
यस्य दिव्यानि कर्माणि प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ।
तान्यहं कीर्तयिष्यामि भक्त्या स्थैर्यार्थमात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: His divine deeds the wise proclaim. I shall recount them with devotion, for the steadiness of my own mind.
